title: Content Safety Gate v1
description: Wide protocol gate that evaluates content body / artifact payload safety for ContentPublish, AttestationWrite, and PeerMessage events. Three-node DAG: assemble → wisdom-safety → synthesize. Fires before specialised domain gates (discernment, reach). Emits Allow or Decline{category:content-safety}. No side effects — read-only governance check. Phase 6 DevContext: mocked Allow (no content blocked in rehearsal). Phase 7+ activation calls ContentSafetyReview capability via skill-invoke.
